dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Hohoho! I’ve found quite the haul today!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Hohoho! Eu encontrei uma bela carga hoje!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,9)>Wh-what was that? <$lookat(1,2,0)>Who’s there?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,9)>O que foi isso? <$lookat(1,2,0)>Quem está aí?!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)>Gadzooks! What in the world is a human doing here?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)>I didn’t think there were any left!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)>Gadzooks! O que diabos um humano está fazendo aqui?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)>Eu não achava que ainda havia algum!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm? There’s something curious about you... <$voicel(1,2)>Are you
REALLY a human?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm? Há algo curioso sobre você... <$voicel(1,2)>está a...
REALMENTE um humano?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)>Those simple eyes... That slack mouth... <$voicel(1,8)>Hrm?! Wait a
moment...
<$voicel(1,9)>Are you a <$cdef(27)>Ditto?! My, what an impressive transformation!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)>Aqueles olhos simples... essa boca frouxa... <$voicel(1,8)>Espera um pouco.
momento...
<$voicel(1,9)>Você é... <$cdef(27)>DittoNossa, que transformação impressionante!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)>Oho! So you’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, eh? <$voicel(1,10)>What an impressive
transformation!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)>Oho! Então você é um <$cdef(27)>Ditto, eh? <$voicel(1,10)>Que impressionante.
transformação!

dialogues.en:
*deedle-beep!*
<$cdef(27)>Owner detected. Beginning backup battery boot up.
dialogues.pt_br:
*Deedle-beep!*
<$cdef(27)>Proprietário detetado. Iniciando arranque da bateria de backup.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm? What’s that sound? Where’s it coming from?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm? Que som é esse? De onde vem?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Where’s that sound coming from? Can you find
the source?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>De onde vem esse som?
A fonte?

dialogues.en:
You found a <$cdef(27)>Pokédex! It’s even equipped with a camera
that can take selfies!
dialogues.pt_br:
Encontraste um... <$cdef(27)>Pokédex! Ele está equipado com uma câmera
que pode tirar selfies!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,32)>Oho! That’s a <$cdef(27)>Pokédex </color>I found ages ago!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,32)>Oho! Isso é um <$cdef(27)>Pokédex </color>Encontrei-o há séculos!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Is that so? I had thought that Pokédex was beyond repair,
<$voicel(1,8)>but it started working as soon as you appeared...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Pensei que o Pokédex não tinha solução.
<$voicel(1,8)>Mas começou a funcionar assim que apareceste...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$emotion(1,9)>You’re welcome to keep it.
<$voicel(1,3)>I haven’t the foggiest idea how to use the thing.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$emotion(1,9)>Você é bem-vindo para mantê-lo.
<$voicel(1,3)>Eu não tenho a menor idéia de como usar a coisa.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,9)>Yes, it was already in pretty sorry shape when I found it.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,13)>I’d thought that old gizmo was broken, but it started
working again just as you showed up...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,9)>Sim, já estava em estado deplorável quando o encontrei.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,13)>Eu pensei que o velho aparelho estava quebrado, mas começou
Trabalhando de novo assim que apareceste...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$emotion(1,9)>You’re welcome to keep that Pokédex.
<$voicel(1,5)>I haven’t the foggiest idea how to use it.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$emotion(1,9)>Você é bem-vindo para manter esse Pokédex.
<$voicel(1,5)>Eu não tenho a menor idéia de como usá-lo.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)>Your human transformation really is quite impressive,
you know.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>And now that you’re holding a Pokédex, you look just like
a Pokémon Trainer!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,666)>Could it be you’ve based that look of yours on your
own Trainer?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)>A tua transformação humana é realmente impressionante.
Tu sabe.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>E agora que você está segurando um Pokédex, você se parece com
Um treinador Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,666)>Poderia ser que você baseou esse seu olhar em seu
O próprio Trainer?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Hohoho! I’m sure you and your Trainer must have been
<$voicel(1,8)>splendid partners.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Hohoho! Tenho certeza que você e seu instrutor devem ter sido
<$voicel(1,8)>Esplêndidos parceiros.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,6)>By the by, did that Trainer give you a name?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,6)>A propósito, aquele treinador deu-te um nome?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,9)>Ahhh, so you were called <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,9)>Ahhh, então você foi chamado <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,23)><$comeff(1,1)>That’s a snazzy one!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,23)><$comeff(1,1)>Isso é um snazzy!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,652)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$motion(1,836)><$comeff(1,10)>That has an interesting ring to it.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,652)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$motion(1,836)><$comeff(1,10)>Isso soa-lhe bem.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,652)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,1)><$comeff(1,8)>That’s quite darling.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,652)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,1)><$comeff(1,8)>Isso é muito querido.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,23)>That’s got a cheerful ring to it.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,23)>Isso tem um som alegre para ele.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,8)>What an enchanting name.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, eh? <$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,8)>Que nome encantador.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>In that case, I believe I’ll also take the liberty of calling
you “<$cdef(27)>.”
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>Nesse caso, eu acredito que eu também vou tomar a liberdade de chamar
“<$cdef(27)>.”

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>I see, I see. <$voicel(1,6)>I’m sure you were quite the special <$cdef(27)>Ditto
to your Trainer.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>Estou a ver. <$voicel(1,6)>Tenho certeza de que você foi muito especial <$cdef(27)>Ditto
Para o seu treinador.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,23)>In that case, I believe I’ll also take the liberty of calling
you <$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,23)>Nesse caso, eu acredito que eu também vou tomar a liberdade de chamar
você <$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en:
It seems like there’s something in <$cdef(27)>Tangrowth’s home.
<$cdef(27)>Try looking around there first!
dialogues.pt_br:
Parece que há alguma coisa dentro <$cdef(27)>TangrowthÉ o lar.
<$cdef(27)>Tenta dar uma vista de olhos primeiro!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,31)>It’s been quite some time since I last laid eyes on
either a human or a Pokémon...
<$voicel(1,5)>Then, out of nowhere, I come across a Pokémon in the
shape of a human! How curious.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,31)>Já faz algum tempo desde que eu vi pela última vez
Ou um humano ou um Pokémon...
<$voicel(1,5)>Então, do nada, encontrei um Pokémon no
Que curioso.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)>Hrm?
<$voicel(1,5)>You mean...you don’t know what’s happened here?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,839)>Right, then. Come with me.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)>Hrm?
<$voicel(1,5)>Você quer dizer... você não sabe o que aconteceu aqui?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,839)>Certo, então, vem comigo.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,1)>This place was once home to many humans...
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>But now it’s... Well, what you see.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,1)>Este lugar já foi lar de muitos humanos...
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>Mas agora é... bem, o que você vê.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)>The grass and trees are withered and dry. And all those
humans and Pokémon who once lived here... <$voicel(1,2)>They’re gone.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)>A erva e as árvores estão secas e secas.
Humanos e Pokémon que já viveram aqui... <$voicel(1,2)>Eles se foram.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)>But my question is, where have YOU been this whole—
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)>Mas a minha pergunta é, onde é que estiveste todo este...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)>Hm?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)>Hm?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)>What’s that on the ground over there? Could it be
a Pokémon?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)>O que é isso no chão ali? Poderia ser
Um Pokémon?!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)>Come on, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Let’s go see!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)>Vamos. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>Vamos ver!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>This way!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>Por aqui!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,5)>Wh-what could have happened?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,5)>O que poderia ter acontecido?!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,2)>Nnngh...
Wa...water...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,2)>Nnngh...
Wa...water...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Well, I’ll be gobsmacked! If it isn’t a <$cdef(27)>Squirtle! And they’re
nearly all dried up!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Bem, eu vou ser gobsmacked! Se não é um <$cdef(27)>Squirtle! E eles são
Quase toda seca!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,827)>Here I thought <$cdef(27)>Squirtle were supposed to have an
excellent command of water...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,827)>Aqui eu pensei <$cdef(27)>Squirtle era suposto ter um
excelente comando de água...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,654)><$emotion(1,31)>Isn’t there anything we can do to help?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,654)><$emotion(1,31)>Não podemos fazer nada para ajudar?!

dialogues.en:
Did you notice the <$cdef(27)>speech bubble that popped up over
<$cdef(27)>Squirtle’s head?
When a Pokémon wants to tell you something, a <$cdef(27)>speech
bubble will appear above them.
It looks like <$cdef(27)>Squirtle may have a pretty serious problem—
you should try talking to them!
dialogues.pt_br:
Reparaste no... <$cdef(27)>bolha de fala que apareceu.
<$cdef(27)>SquirtleA cabeça?
Quando um Pokémon quer dizer-te uma coisa, <$cdef(27)>discurso
bolha aparecerão por cima deles.
Parece que sim. <$cdef(27)>Squirtle pode ter um problema muito grave -
Devias tentar falar com eles!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,2)>Nnngh...
Wa...water...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,2)>Nnngh...
Wa...water...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,667)><$facial(1,9)>Is there anything we can do to help <$cdef(27)>Squirtle</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,667)><$facial(1,9)>Há alguma coisa que possamos fazer para ajudar <$cdef(27)>Squirtle</color>?

dialogues.en:
If a Pokémon looks like they want to tell you something,
try talking to them!
dialogues.pt_br:
Se um Pokémon parece querer dizer-te alguma coisa,
Tenta falar com eles!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)>Uggghhh... What’s with this place? Where’s...the water...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)>Uggghhh... O que há com este lugar? Onde está... a água...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)>Rrrgh... Usually I can spray all the water I want...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)>Normalmente, posso pulverizar toda a água que quiser.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)>Ahhh... If only there were...another healthy Squirtle around
to help me...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)>Se ao menos houvesse outro Squirtle saudável por perto.
Para me ajudar...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>I must say, I’ve seen better transformations in my time...
<$facial(1,1)>but it looks like you can use <$cdef(27)>Squirtle’s move!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Devo dizer, já vi melhores transformações no meu tempo...
<$facial(1,1)>mas parece que você pode usar <$cdef(27)>SquirtleAgitar!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>Can you use that move to <$cdef(27)>rescue Squirtle</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>Pode usar esse movimento para <$cdef(27)>Resgate Squirtle</color>?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>Can you use that move to <$cdef(27)>rescue Squirtle</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>Pode usar esse movimento para <$cdef(27)>Resgate Squirtle</color>?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$textsize(2)>GWAH!!!</textsize><wait(2.0)>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$textsize(2)>GWAH!!!</textsize><wait(2.0)>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,9)>Good grief! Why in the world would you squirt water
on ME?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,9)>Meu Deus, por que raio haverias de esguichar água?
Comigo? !

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,824)>I’m not the one who needs the water. <$cdef(27)>Splash it on Squirtle
for pity’s sake!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,824)>Não sou eu que preciso da água. <$cdef(27)>Espalhem-no no Squirtle
Pelo amor de Deus!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$textsize(2)>GWAH!!!</textsize><wait(2.0)>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$textsize(2)>GWAH!!!</textsize><wait(2.0)>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,7)><$motion(1,825)><$cdef(27)>! I haven’t withered away yet,
you know!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,7)><$motion(1,825)><$cdef(27)>! Eu ainda não murchei,
Tu sabe!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,1)>It’s the dried-up grass and flowers you should be
watering—not me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,1)>É a grama seca e flores que você deve ser
a molhar-me, não a mim!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)>I’m saved!!!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)>Eu sou salvo!!!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Thank you so much! I really thought I was done for!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Muito obrigado! Eu realmente pensei que eu estava feito!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)>I owe you my life...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)>Devo-te a minha vida...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,6)>Huh? Something’s beeping...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,6)>Alguma coisa está a apitar...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)>Oho! Looks like that Pokédex still works after all!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)>Parece que o Pokédex ainda funciona!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$lookat(0,1,1)>Though, it truly has been an age since I last saw any
other Pokémon.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>That Pokédex’s days of being useful may be long over...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$lookat(0,1,1)>Embora, tenha sido realmente uma idade desde a última vez que vi algum
outro Pokémon.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Que os dias de Pokédex de ser útil pode ser longo mais...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Thanks again for splashing me! That really helped me out.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Obrigado de novo por me teres espalhado!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>I dunno why the dirt and plants and stuff around here are
all so dry...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Não sei porque é que a terra, as plantas e as coisas por aqui são...
Tudo tão seco...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)>But it looks like the place perks up again when
you get things wet with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)>Mas parece que o lugar se anima novamente quando
você fica molhado com as coisas <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)>!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Maybe you can <$cdef(27)>water this area more to help the grass grow</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Talvez possas. <$cdef(27)>água esta área mais para ajudar a grama crescer</color>!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Thanks again for splashing me! That really helped me out.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>Obrigado de novo por me teres espalhado!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>I dunno why the dirt and plants and stuff around here are
all so dry...
